main_text.p: nes faciunt, qui in clariffima Euangelii luce executiunt. Lyræ igitur iudicio, Ecclesia non consistit ex iis, in quibus nulla est interna vir-tus. Iohannes Wiclefus Mertonensis noster, hanc opinionem, quæ improbos, etiam da-mnatos homines, Ecclesiæ Catholicæ mem-bra esse finxerat, primum inter priuatas opi-niones fraterculorum inuectam refert. Refe-a tract.contr. frat. cap. 39.ram verba eius Anglice, sicut scripta sunt: a Friars destroyen this article of Christian mens faith, Iheleine o common or generall Churche[?]. For they teachen that tho men that shalbe damned be members of holy Churche. And thus they vvedden Christ, and the deuil together: id est, Fratres hunc articulum fidei Christianæ destruunt: Credo Ecclesiam Catholicam. Docent enim, homines damnandos membra esse Ecclesiæ sanctæ: & sic Diabolum cum Christo connubio coniungunt. Ita Wiclefus origi-nem erroris huius notat, quam à fraterculis primum inuectam demonstrat: quos testatur horrendo coniugio Christum cum Diabolo copulasse: quam absurditatem nullo modo effugere possunt, qui membra Ecclesiæ, qui sunt & membra Christi, docent esse sine o-mni interna virtute: ita enim & membra Dia-dist.14. q.4.boli Christo coniungunt. Gratianus in hanc sententiam quædam etiam ex veteribus Scri-ptoribus colligit, ut probet, impios ab Ecclesia separari per vitam malam. Agnoscit Gratia-nus, longe aliam fuisse Romanæ Ecclesiæ do-ctrinam (illo quo scripsit ipse seculo,) quam hodie promulgant Iesuitæ, de membris Ec-clesiæ.

page.notes: Left printed page: the text column is complete. Two marginal notes are on the left: "a tract.contr. frat. cap. 39." and "dist.14. q.4.". The first note's mark "a" does not appear in the text, so it is not linked. The English quotation is in italics. Doubtful readings: "Iheleine" (marked [?]) and "o common" are not certain. The right printed page is cut off at the scan's right edge, so its lines are fragments; the letters are uncertain and some are marked [?]. The right-page fragments are taken as seen, and their order is not verified.
